nodes.label: Edge AI & WebRTC Architecture
nodes.rationale: MediaPipe Pose runs locally on Pi 5 while WebRTC streams peer-to-peer without recording video frames to database.

nodes.label: Data Retention & Excel Reporting Policy
nodes.rationale: Retain granular minute summaries for 35 days and aggregate daily summaries for 365 days to maintain historical stats while minimizing storage.

nodes.label: Docker Compose Deployment & Token Auth
nodes.rationale: Enforces POSTUREAI_ADMIN_TOKEN generation via openssl to secure settings mutations and data deletion endpoints.
